2026-10-28TCFinancial Administration ActAppointment of a director of the board of directors of VIA Rail Canada Inc.Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Transport of Katherine Di Tomaso of Toronto, Ontario, to be a director of the board of directors of VIA Rail Canada Inc., to hold office during pleasure for a term of four years, in the place of Gail Louise Stephens, whose term has expired.N/A
subject: Appointment of a director of the board of directors of VIA Rail Canada Inc.
precis: Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Transport of Katherine Di Tomaso of Toronto, Ontario, to be a director of the board of directors of VIA Rail Canada Inc., to hold office during pleasure for a term of four years, in the place of Gail Louise Stephens, whose term has expired.
